raw:
@q query
  mode count
  select ?s
  where all
    match
      relation "be in"
      role subject ?s
      role object "Covasna County"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "have enrolled"
      role subject ?s
      role object ?n
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
  compare ?n below 50
  except ?s "Târgu Secuiesc"
